name: Anomaly Detection
description: Flag unusual payments against historical payrun data.

config.description: Flag unusual payments against historical payrun data.
config.instructions: Compare each employee's current payments with their historical completed payruns. Explain calculated changes in gross pay, net pay, overtime, bonuses and deductions. Treat duplicate lines and post-termination pay as items for human review. Identify limited history. Do not change payroll.
questions: How does this employee's pay compare with their history?
